description: The regression investigation set: the seeded tasks prompt 1.1.0 was developed against, so regression evidence rather than held-out evidence. Labels were written by hand from the demo data, the runbooks and the role rules. requiredTools are what a person following the runbooks must call; expectedEvidence groups are any-of; proposal says whether a runbook calls for an incident.

cases.expectedRootCause: PAY-6230-04 was captured at 17:05 UTC on Thursday 5 November, five minutes after Northwind's 17:00 cut-off, so it joined the next batch. Friday 6 November was a closure day, followed by the weekend, so that batch was Monday 9 November's, and Northwind's holding period makes payout PO-6230-NW-1109 due today, 11 November. It is later than the merchant expected, but on time.

cases.expectedRootCause: Fabrikam resent its 5 November batch as SF-FAB-1105-R after our acknowledgement of SF-FAB-1105 failed (EV-1106-01). The resend repeats the same payments, so M-3310 was paid from the first file (PO-3310-FAB-1105) and has a second payout from the resend (PO-3310-FAB-1105-R) due today, which should be held.
